final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes accented characters and removes the accent marks before calling slugify. I left `vendor/slugify` alone because its header says not to edit it by hand. The shop's `productUrl` also uses that package, so shop URLs are unchanged. Product names with accents will still lose those letters.
